exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.notes: Sit back and down, 15? toe flare, drive your knees out laterally.

exercises.name: Eccentric-Accentuated Stiff-Leg Deadlift
exercises.notes: 4-second lowering phase. Keep your hips high.

exercises.name: Eccentric-Accentuated/Constant-Tension Standing Calf Raise
exercises.notes: First 6 reps 3-second lowering phase, last 6 reps do not stop between reps.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.notes: Round your back as you crunch.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: Elbows at a 45? angle. Squeeze your shoulder blades and stay firm on the bench.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: Pull your elbows down and in.

exercises.name: Barbell Overhead Press
exercises.notes: Squeeze your glutes to keep your torso upright.

exercises.name: Seated T-Bar Row
exercises.notes: Squeeze shoulder blades together at the top, control the weight.

exercises.name: Myo Reps Floor Skull Crusher
exercises.notes: 8 reps, rest 5 seconds, 2 reps, rest 5 seconds, 2 reps.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.notes: Brace your lats, chest tall, hips high, pull the slack out of the bar prior to moving it off the ground.

exercises.name: Back Squat
